edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Publicly expresses disapproval or challenges the actions of another entity.

edge_types.name: SUPPORTS
edge_types.description: Publicly endorses or aligns with the viewpoints/actions of another entity.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Disseminates information or news regarding the activities of an entity.

edge_types.name: ADVOCATES_FOR
edge_types.description: Promotes a specific policy, reform, or social cause.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal or informal dialogue to resolve conflicts or reach accords.

edge_types.name: WORKS_FOR
edge_types.description: Indicates employment or official affiliation with an organization or party.

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Exerts power or shapes the decision-making process of another entity.

edge_types.name: OPPOSES
edge_types.description: Actively works against the interests or survival of another entity.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex social media interactions surrounding Thailand's 2025 polycrisis. It captures the tension between the 'Blue' conservative establishment (BJT), the reformist opposition (PP), and the military, alongside the economic and environmental anxieties of the public. Entity types focus on the key actors mentioned—politicians, diplomats, and media—while relationships reflect the 'lawfare', nationalist rhetoric, and diplomatic maneuvering described in the text.
